maddeler.e:
نحترف (form VIII)
# نَحْتَرِفُ (naḥtarifu) /naħ.ta.ri.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# نُحْتَرَفُ (nuḥtarafu) /nuħ.ta.ra.fu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# نَحْتَرِفَ (naḥtarifa) /naħ.ta.ri.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# نُحْتَرَفَ (nuḥtarafa) /nuħ.ta.ra.fa/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
